SECTION 1: HERO

Headline (H1):

Your AI team is ready.

Subheadline:

Corner gives your business a team of AI agents that handles scheduling,

SECTION 2: THE PROBLEM

Section label (small caps, muted):

WHY CORNER EXISTS

Intro line:

You're good at your work. You're drowning in everything around it.

3 Problem Cards:

Card 1 Title: You're the bottleneck. Body: 15-20 hours a week on scheduling, emails, follow-up, and admin. Leads fall through cracks. Clients wait too long. You're doing everything because no one else can.

Card 2 Title: Tools don't fix it. Body: You've tried Zapier, ChatGPT, project management apps. They add more screens to check, not fewer hours to work. Another subscription that doesn't know your business.

Card 3 Title: Hiring is expensive. Body: A part-time office manager costs $30-40k a year. A marketing person costs $50k+. And they still need managing. You're not ready to hire — but you need the help now.

SECTION 3: THE SOLUTION

Section label (small caps, muted):

WHAT CORNER IS

Headline:

Not another tool. A team.

Body:

Corner gives you AI agents that specialize. One handles your calendar.
One manages client follow-up. One does your outreach. One creates content.
One checks everyone's work. They remember your business, talk to each other,
and hand off work without being asked.

You open your office in the morning. The work is already moving.

Visual:

  • Full-width isometric office screenshot with labeled rooms
  • Labels: "Scheduler" / "Follow-Up" / "Content" / "QA" / "Outreach"
  • Caption below: This is what an AI operations team looks like.

3 proof lines (icons + text):

✓  They work while you sleep.
✓  They remember everything you've told them.
✓  They get better every week.

SECTION 4: HOW IT WORKS

Section label (small caps, muted):

HOW IT WORKS

Headline:

Ready in 48 hours.

3 Steps:

Step 1 — Free Discovery Call Title: We audit your business. Body: 30 minutes. We map your operations, find where time is lost, and identify which agents save you the most. No charge. No commitment.

Step 2 — We Build Your Team Title: Your office goes live. Body: In 48 hours, your Corner office is set up with agents trained on your business. Your clients, your workflows, your language.

Step 3 — You Run Your Business Title: Open Corner each morning. Body: Your agents handled overnight follow-ups, drafted client responses, organized your tasks, and flagged anything that needs you. Review, approve, move on.

Below steps:

No setup guide. No onboarding video.
Your team figures it out.

One flat monthly rate. Cancel anytime.

Subhead:

30-day money-back guarantee. If Corner doesn't save you time, you don't pay.

CTA: [Contact Us]

Below pricing cards:

All plans include: 48-hour setup. 30-day money-back guarantee.
Month-to-month. Cancel anytime. Your data is always yours.

SECTION 6: PROOF

Section label (small caps, muted):

WHO'S RUNNING ON CORNER

Headline:

AOM runs its entire business on Corner.

Body:

We built Corner for ourselves before we sold it to anyone else.
AOM runs 14 agents across client projects, video production, brand work,
outreach, and operations. Every day. This is the proof.

Stats row (4 stats):

689 commits shipped    |    14 active agents    |    89 built skills    |    200+ hours saved/month

Case study link:

Read the AOM case study →

Placeholder for first client testimonial:

[Testimonial coming in April — first customer cohort]

Note for Bobby: when the first real testimonial exists, swap this placeholder with a quote card (name, photo, business, quote, specific metric).

SECTION 7: FAQ

Section label (small caps, muted):

COMMON QUESTIONS

Headline:

We've heard these before.

6 FAQ Items (accordion):

Q1: What happens if an agent makes a mistake? Every agent's work goes through a QA agent before it reaches you. You review and approve. Nothing ships without your say.

Q2: Can I talk to my agents? Yes. Same as messaging a coworker. Type a message in Corner's chat. Your agent responds, remembers what you said, and acts on it. They're not bots. They're your team.

Q3: What if I want to change how things work? Your AOM account manager adjusts agents, adds new skills, and reconfigures workflows anytime. Included in your plan. No extra charge.

Q4: How is this different from just using ChatGPT? ChatGPT answers one question at a time and forgets everything when you close the tab. Corner runs six agents in parallel, connected to your actual business, around the clock. Your agents know your clients, your projects, and your preferences. ChatGPT doesn't know your name.

Q5: What happens if I want to cancel? Month-to-month. Cancel anytime. We export all your data before you go. No lock-in.

Q6: Is my business data safe? Your data is isolated to your own Corner instance. It's not shared with other businesses or used to train any AI. We're on the SOC 2 compliance roadmap and treat your data the way we'd want our own treated.

SECTION 8: FINAL CTA

Headline:

Your team is two minutes away.

Body:

Book a free 30-minute call. We'll show you Corner running on a live business,
map out how it would work for yours, and answer every question.
No slides. No pitch deck. Just the product.

DESIGN NOTES FOR STEFFEN

  • White (#FFFFFF) background throughout. No gray. No dark sections.
  • One accent color for all CTAs. You call the specific color — warm, not aggressive.
  • Isometric office art appears in Hero (large, 50% opacity) and Solution (full section).
  • Font: Patrik likes SF/Helvetica energy. Clean sans for body, slightly expressive for H1.
  • Section labels: small caps, 11-12px, muted (#999), tracked +0.15em.
  • H1: 60-72px desktop, 36-40px mobile.
  • Max content width: 1120px. Bleed sections: full-width.
  • Motion: slow fade-ups (600ms). Parallax on office art (0.3x). Nothing jumps.
  • Pricing cards: Growth card gets visual emphasis (border, slight scale, "Most Popular" badge).
  • FAQ: accordion with smooth open/close. Max two open at once.

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES FOR BOBBY

  • Page: /corner on aheadofmarket.com
  • Calendar embed section: use existing /book booking method (Calendly embed)
  • Stats in Section 6 can be hardcoded initially. Later: pull from a config file Patrik updates.
  • Pricing CTAs: "Get Started" and "Book a Demo" both link to /book for now. Stripe comes Week 4.
  • "Watch the demo →" in final CTA links to /demo
  • Mobile-first. All sections stack cleanly at 390px.
  • Before shipping: confirm all CTA links resolve (no 404s)
